director.name: 若纳塔斯·德·安德拉德 Jonathas de Andrade

introduction: Jonathas de Andrade, a Brazilian artist whose work revolves around social issues, engages in a dialogue between fiction and reality, tradition and negotiation with local communities. In this film, he proposes a reflection on generational changes, exploring the relationship between humans and pigeons. In front of the camera, pigeon fanciers and birds interact before the apotheotic moment of release.
